mechanism: Foscarnet can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities that may impair folate metabolism and utilization; folic acid supplementation may be needed to counteract foscarnet-related hematologic toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and complete blood count regularly; consider folic acid supplementation if hematologic toxicity develops, but ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte management with foscarnet therapy.
